name: Frightened
description:
A {{effraye}} creature cannot willingly move closer to what frightens it. While it can see what frightens it, it suffers 1 {{desavantage}} on its {{jet|Rolls}} and {{attaque|Attacks}}.

At the end of each of its turns, it makes a {{esprit}} + {{volonte}} {{jet}} against the {{dd}} of the Skill that frightened it. On a success, the state ends.
